name: United Alloy-Tech Company
summary: Established in 1991 and headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan, United Alloy-Tech Company Ltd primarily specializes in the forging, fabrication, marketing, and distribution of aluminum alloys. The company maintains a significant international footprint, conducting business across Taiwan, mainland China, Southeast Asia, North America (United States), and Europe, among other global regions. Beyond its core aluminum alloy operations, its diverse portfolio also encompasses the die-casting, manufacturing, and refinement of molds; the production and sale of automotive components, notably car battery housings; the processing and creation of various tapes, foams, and other aluminum materials; and the provision of asset rental services.
